stories.label: Iran war Day 8+: 742+ killed, US Embassy in Riyadh hit, Trump says 4-5 weeks
stories.summary: Day 8: Death toll 742+ (up from 555). US Embassy in Riyadh hit by drones. Trump says 4-5 weeks, ground troops not ruled out. Congress war powers vote pending. Spain blocking US bases. Kuwait friendly fire incident reported. Not selected this cycle — covered extensively over 6 articles.

stories.label: Hormuz closed, insurers pull war cover, oil spikes 13%
stories.summary: Hormuz still 'closed' by IRGC. 750+ ships backed up. Insurers pulling war cover. Oil spiked 13%. Korean KOSPI triggered circuit breaker. European gas doubled. Qatar LNG halted. AWS Dubai still down. Not selected — covered extensively already.

stories.label: US Marines fire on Karachi protesters — Pakistan destabilizing
stories.summary: US Marines opened fire on Pakistani protesters who stormed the Karachi consulate. At least 10 killed. US suspended all visa appointments across Pakistan. Pro-Iran protests, IMF dependency, Afghan border war — triple crisis in a nuclear state.

stories.label: Russian strikes hit 3-year peak — 288 missiles in February
stories.summary: 288 overnight missiles in February — highest in 3 years. Passenger train hit, 8 killed. Russia escalating while Iran war consumes global attention and US military bandwidth. Peace talks expected in March. Ukraine hit key Russian oil terminal.

stories.label: Milei's legislative blitz: labour reform, criminal age lowered, glacier law weakened
stories.summary: Milei rammed through labour reform, lowered criminal age to 14, and weakened glacier protections — all in one week. Unions filed constitutional challenge. Opposition fractured. Most rapid legislative transformation Argentina has seen in decades.

stories.label: US opens chip door for Vietnam, locks it on China
stories.summary: Washington lifts export controls on Vietnam, transforming it from chip assembly hub to potential manufacturing partner. Strategic alternative to China in global semiconductor supply chain.

stories.label: Ultra-sensitive CAR T cells eliminate hard-to-treat tumours
stories.summary: Engineered immune cells with dramatically heightened sensitivity detect and destroy tumours that evade conventional immunotherapy. Demonstrated in mice. Potential to treat currently untreatable cancers.

stories.label: Super agers' brains keep producing new neurons into their 80s
stories.summary: People over 80 who remain mentally sharp actively generate new hippocampal neurons at rates comparable to people decades younger. Challenges assumption that neurogenesis stops with age.

stories.label: Meta smart glasses workers can see everything wearers see
stories.summary: Swedish investigation reveals workers processing Meta smart glasses data can see everything wearers see — homes, conversations, children's faces. Human surveillance infrastructure behind 'AI' features. Millions of units sold.

stories.label: Russia to block Telegram in April — 100M+ users
stories.summary: Two Kremlin sources say decision is 'final.' Telegram is Russia's primary messaging platform. Last major channel for anti-war organizing and independent news. Follows Durov arrest in France.

stories.label: Khamenei killed: interim council active, succession race underway
stories.summary: Interim council (Arafi, president, chief justice) leading Iran. Assembly of Experts hasn't convened. Succession crisis ongoing amid active war.

stories.label: Iran civilian death toll 742+, school strike 180+ killed
stories.summary: Death toll now 742+ (rights group count). School strike toll 180+. 131 cities affected. War crimes evidence mounting.

stories.label: Most Americans oppose Iran war — Congress to debate war powers
stories.summary: Only 25% of Americans approve strikes. Congress war powers vote still pending.

stories.label: Lebanon bans Hezbollah military activities — Israel strikes kill 52
stories.summary: Lebanon PM banned Hezbollah military activities. Hezbollah rejected it. Israel ordered evacuation of 50 locations, then struck — 52 killed. War expanding into Lebanon.

stories.label: Macron expands France's nuclear arsenal, offers nuclear aircraft to allies
stories.summary: France expanding nuclear arsenal and offering nuclear-armed aircraft to allies. Europe divided. Driven by US distraction with Iran and wavering NATO credibility.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: crossings closed, Al-Aqsa shut, aid halted under Iran war cover
stories.summary: Total siege continues. All crossings sealed. 37 aid orgs halted. Al-Aqsa shut during Ramadan. Only days of fuel left. Iran war providing cover.

stories.label: US Treasury drops Claude after Anthropic rejected Pentagon AI demands
stories.summary: US Treasury ended all Anthropic/Claude use. Government retaliation after Anthropic refused Pentagon demand to drop AI safeguards. OpenAI took the deal. AI used in Iran strikes regardless.

stories.label: Mass graves in eastern DRC — US sanctions Rwanda's military
stories.summary: US sanctioned Rwanda's army chief and others. Mass graves near Uvira. Rwanda hasn't responded. EU follow-up unclear.

stories.label: Nepal's first post-protest election March 5
stories.summary: Nepal votes March 5. New protest-born parties vs. old guard. Results expected within days.

stories.label: India-Canada nuclear energy deal resets ties
stories.summary: Canada-India nuclear energy deal including uranium supply. Dramatic reversal after Nijjar assassination fallout.

stories.label: 170+ killed in South Sudan's Ruweng — MSF staff missing
stories.summary: ~170 killed in single attack. MSF staff missing. UN peacekeepers sheltering 1,000 civilians. UN warns of return to civil war.

stories.label: Israel shuts Al-Aqsa during Ramadan under Iran war cover
stories.summary: Al-Aqsa shut during Ramadan. Combined with sealed crossings, settler violence. Iran war cover for intensified repression.

stories.label: Prediction markets: war death bets, suspected insider trading
stories.summary: Kalshi and Polymarket hosting war death bets. Nasdaq now joining binary bets market. $1.2M insider trading suspected.

stories.label: India's $60bn river storage plan threatens Pakistan's water
stories.summary: India investing $60bn in storage on rivers flowing into Pakistan. Indus Waters Treaty under strain.

stories.label: El Niño may return in 2026, stacking warming on record temperatures
stories.summary: El Niño forecast. Would make hottest period ever get hotter. Global South and Pacific islands most affected.

stories.label: Sudan war — fading from global attention
stories.summary: Crisis continues. Iran war consuming all bandwidth.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — attention pulled by Iran war
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts. Iran war diverting attention.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan border war
stories.summary: Fighting continuing. No signs of de-escalation. Part of broader Pakistan destabilization.

stories.label: Data centers racing to space — beyond regulation
stories.summary: Companies launching data centers into orbit, beyond regulation. Connected to AWS Dubai destruction.

stories.label: Fiji severe flooding
stories.summary: Flooding in Western Division. Schools closed.

stories.label: AWS data centers in Dubai destroyed by Iranian missiles
stories.summary: Amazon confirms drones damaged three facilities in UAE and Bahrain. First time major cloud infrastructure physically destroyed by warfare.

stories.label: US intelligence shared Khamenei location with Israel
stories.summary: US disclosed Khamenei's location to Israel. May violate Executive Order 12333.
